{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Model consistently underestimates prices during bullish sentiment (sentiment > 0.00), especially in late cycles or after recent spikes.",
    "Model overestimates prices in early cycles or after sharp declines, showing lagged reaction to sentiment shifts.",
    "After a price spike, model forecasts often overshoot and fail to mean-revert, particularly when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "In low-sentiment periods, model tends to underestimate true price movements, especially when historical mean is rising.",
    "Model exhibits persistent bias toward lower prices in the first 10 days of a new cycle, requiring upward adjustment based on sentiment and recent volatility.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, model should apply a 5-10% upward bias to avoid underestimating momentum.",
    "In high-sentiment periods, model should adjust for volatility clustering — increase forecast range or apply smoothing to avoid overreaction."
  ]
}
